files.content:
# Webhook retry backlog runbook brief

Scenario: use this when the `webhook_retry_backlog` queue exceeds 5,000 jobs for more than 10 minutes and customer invoice webhooks are delayed. Do not use it during an active database outage or while Stripe status is degraded.
Prerequisites: production Kubernetes access, PagerDuty incident role, `kubectl` context `prod-us`, Datadog dashboard access, and permission to scale worker deployment `webhook-worker`.
Safe commands: `kubectl -n payments get deploy webhook-worker`, `kubectl -n payments scale deploy webhook-worker --replicas=12`, `kubectl -n payments logs deploy/webhook-worker --tail=200`, `kubectl -n payments scale deploy webhook-worker --replicas=4`.
Success: backlog below 500 jobs, p95 webhook delay below 2 minutes, error rate below 1% for 15 minutes.
Rollback: scale workers back to 4 replicas and pause retries if error rate rises above 3%.
Escalation: page Payments Primary after 20 minutes without improvement; page Database On-call if DB CPU exceeds 85%.
Risk: scaling workers too high can overload the database.
